basis.speed: inherited B1 descriptive5m/s, not a scientific congestion threshold
basis.grid: legacy50m retained for comparison, not selected on C
basis.count: at least two vehicles to observe a spatial following relation
basis.gap: 10m=two synthetic5m vehicle lengths; no empirical queue-gap identification
basis.duration: two1s intervals/three snapshots; test-scale candidate, not a traffic persistence claim
basis.inlet: same physical first50m support as B1; inclusion now uses observed bodies and uncertainty
basis.uncertainty: 0.01m synthetic coordinate assumption; future mapping precision must be verified

entry_support_requires: downstream anchored physical queue in same lane/path
absence_of_queue_qualification: mechanism finding or warning, not itself a physics failure
quality_error: measurement invalid; can be an engineering blocker under a future approved plan
